content: इति {%ind.%} .²1 this particle is most generally used to report the very words spoken or supposed to be spoken by some one, as represented by quotation marks in <lang>English</lang>. The speech reported may be (1) a single word used merely to express what the form of the word is, when it is used as it is (शब्दस्वरूपद्योतक); कूजन्तं रामरामेति मधुरं मधुराक्षरम् <ls>Rāmarakṣā.</ls> अत एव गवित्याह <ls>Bh.</ls>; (2) or a substantive, which must be put in the nominative case when its meaning is to be indicated (प्रातिपदिकार्थद्योतक); चयस्त्विषामित्यवधारितं पुरा … कमादमुं नारद इत्यबोधि सः <ls>Śi. 1</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">3</ls>; अवैमि चैनामनघेति <ls>R. 14. 40</ls>; दिलीप इति राजेन्दुः <ls>R. 1. 12</ls>; sometimes with <ab>acc.</ab> कैवर्तमिति यं प्राहुः <ls>Ms. 10. 34</ls>; <ls>Bg. 6. 2</ls>; (3) or a whole sentence when इति is merely used at the end of that sentence; (वाक्यार्थद्योतक); ज्ञास्यसि कियद् भुजो मे रक्षति मौर्वींकिणाङ्क इति <ls>Śi. 1. 13</ls>; तयोर्मुनिकुमारयोरन्यतरः कथयति अक्षमालामुपयाचितुमागतोस्मीति <ls>K. 151</ls>. .²2 Besides this general sense इति has the following senses:-- .³({%a%}) Cause, as expressed by ‘because’, ‘since’, ‘on the ground that’, in <lang>English</lang>; वैदेशिकोऽस्मीति पृच्छामि <ls>U.</ls>; पुराणमित्येव नःसाधु सर्वम् <ls>M. 1. 2</ls>, <ab>oft.</ab> with किम् <ab>q. v.</ab> .³({%b%}) Purpose or motive, as expressed by ‘that’, ‘in order that’ शरीरस्य विनाशो मा भूदिति मयेदमुत्क्षिप्य समानीतम् <ls>K. 320</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 37</ls>. .³({%c%}) Thus, to mark the conclusion (<ab>opp.</ab> अथ); इति प्रथमोऽङ्कः thus or here ends the first Act. .³({%d%}) It is often used to include under one head a number of separate objects grouped together; पृथिव्यापस्तेजो वायुराकाशं कालो दिगात्मा मन इति द्रव्याणि <ls>T. S.</ls> .³({%e%}) So, thus, in this manner; इत्युक्तवन्तं परिरभ्य दोर्भ्याम् <ls>Ki. 11. 80</ls>. .³({%f%}) Of this nature or description; गौरश्वः पुरुषो हस्तीति जातिः. .³({%g%}) As follows, to the following effect; रामाभिधानो हरिरित्युवाच <ls>R. 13. 1</ls>. .³({%h%}) As for, in the capacity of, as regards, showing capacity or relation; पितेति स पूज्यः, अध्यापक इति निन्द्यः, शीघ्रमिति सुकरं, निभृतमिति चिन्तनीयं भवेत् <ls>Ś. 3</ls>. .³({%i%}) It is often used with the name of an author to form an {%Avyayibhāva%} <ab>comp.</ab> इतिपाणिनि thus according to Pāṇini. .³({%j%}) Illustration (usually with आदि); इन्दुरिन्दुरिव श्रीमानित्यादौ तदनन्वयः <ls>Chandr.</ls>; गौः शुक्लश्चलो डित्थ इत्यादौ <ls>K. P. 2</ls>. .³({%k%}) A quotation or an opinion accepted; इति पाणिनिः, इत्यापिशलिः, इत्यमरः, विश्वः <ab>&c.</ab> .³({%l%}) It is often used by commentators after quoting a rule in the sense of ‘according to such a rule’; शकि लिङ् च (<ls>P. III. 3. 172</ls>) इति शक्यार्थे लिङ् <ls>Malli.</ls> Other senses mentioned are:-- .³({%m%}) Manifestation. .³({%n%}) Order. .³({%o%}) Arrangement. .³({%p%}) Identity. .³({%q%}) Proximity. .³({%r%}) Visibility. .³({%s%}) Excess or superiority. .³({%t%}) Requiring. (इति स्वरूपे सान्निध्ये विवक्षानियमे मते . हेतौ प्रकारप्रत्यक्षप्रकाशेष्यवधारणे, एवमर्थे समाप्तौ च .. <ls>Hem.</ls>).
